# CONSTRUCTED, NOT RECORDED. Read the second half of README before trusting a
# line of this.
#
# The machine this repository was worked on has no discrete GPU, no
# DKMS-backed device and no unsupported hardware — every device on it is a
# virtio device bound to virtio-pci. So the four states this feature exists to
# surface could not be recorded and are written here instead.
#
# WHAT IS REAL IN THIS FILE: the attribute names, the value formats and the
# symlink shapes are copied from sysfs-recorded.txt, which is a real dump. The
# vendor and device ids are real ids out of pci.ids 2026.02.12. The class codes
# are real PCI and USB class codes.
#
# WHAT IS NOT: that a real RTX 3060, a real r8168 or a real MT7922 present
# themselves with exactly these attributes. Nothing here should ever be quoted
# as evidence about a physical device.
#
# The five cases, and the state each must produce:
#
#   0000:00:00.0  a host bridge with NO DRIVER            -> Working
#                 the case that would make every machine on earth report a
#                 fault if "no driver" meant "broken". Recorded, actually:
#                 this one is copied out of sysfs-recorded.txt.
#   0000:01:00.0  NVIDIA GA106, nouveau bound             -> DriverAvailable
#   0000:02:00.0  Realtek 8168, r8168 bound (DKMS)        -> NeedsRebuild
#   0000:03:00.0  a NIC with NO DRIVER, alias resolvable  -> DriverAvailable
#   3-10          MT7922 Bluetooth, interface unbound     -> NotSupported

DEVICE pci 0000:00:00.0
  ATTR vendor 0x106b
  ATTR device 0x1a05
  ATTR class 0x060000
  ATTR modalias pci:v0000106Bd00001A05sv00000000sd00000000bc06sc00i00
  ATTR subsystem_vendor 0x0000
  ATTR subsystem_device 0x0000
DEVICE pci 0000:01:00.0
  ATTR vendor 0x10de
  ATTR device 0x2504
  ATTR class 0x030000
  ATTR modalias pci:v000010DEd00002504sv00001458sd0000403Ebc03sc00i00
  ATTR subsystem_vendor 0x1458
  ATTR subsystem_device 0x403e
  LINK driver ../../../../bus/pci/drivers/nouveau
DEVICE pci 0000:02:00.0
  ATTR vendor 0x10ec
  ATTR device 0x8168
  ATTR class 0x020000
  ATTR modalias pci:v000010ECd00008168sv00001043sd000086C7bc02sc00i00
  ATTR subsystem_vendor 0x1043
  ATTR subsystem_device 0x86c7
  LINK driver ../../../../bus/pci/drivers/r8168
DEVICE pci 0000:03:00.0
  ATTR vendor 0x8086
  ATTR device 0x15f3
  ATTR class 0x020000
  ATTR modalias pci:v00008086d000015F3sv00008086sd00003000bc02sc00i00
  ATTR subsystem_vendor 0x8086
  ATTR subsystem_device 0x3000
DEVICE usb 3-10
  ATTR idVendor 0e8d
  ATTR idProduct 0616
  ATTR manufacturer MediaTek Inc.
  ATTR product Wireless_Device
  ATTR bDeviceClass e0
  ATTR bDeviceSubClass 01
  ATTR modalias usb:v0E8Dp0616d0100dcE0dsc01dp01icE0isc01ip01in00
DEVICE usb 3-10:1.0
  ATTR modalias usb:v0E8Dp0616d0100dcE0dsc01dp01icE0isc01ip01in00
  ATTR bInterfaceClass e0
